provenance.paper_title: Scaling the Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Visual Memory Mechanism

evidence.paraphrase: Dual-pathway writing compresses visual KV caches and exposes multiple reading strategies.
A fixed visual-memory writer updates compressed KV state as the video grows. For FlexMem, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of compressed visual KV memory.
Information is routed between short and long visual-memory pathways. For FlexMem, this specifically supports migration between memory tiers of compressed visual KV memory.
During operation, FlexMem applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to compressed visual KV memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, FlexMem applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to compressed visual KV memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (compressed visual KV memory) changes through a trained but frozen update module, migration between memory tiers, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
